trust_decision.summary: Whether a write of a model that declares encrypted fields may go out on the resolved client/namespace: at the pinned commit nothing decides it; the schema map is built once per client from static storage options (config/encryption.rb) and PersistenceContext#client hands back any client without checking that its schema_map covers the namespace, so the driver silently writes plaintext.

landing_point.why: The summary names the 'callable database name in encryption schema map'; this is where the database is fetched from storage_options and interpolated into the schema key.

fix_sites.entry_point: Mongo client construction (Mongoid.client / Model.create! on a client with auto_encryption_options) via Clients::Factory#build_auto_encryption_options; callable store_in database:
same; parent model with no own encrypted field but embeds_one an encrypted model (Model.create!)
same; one encrypted embedded model embedded by several parents / twice by one parent / self-embedding
Model.requires_encryption_schema? (new, fix.diff:864-894) used by producer and by PersistenceContext
every persistence/query via Model.collection / mongo_client: Model.create!/save, Model.with(database:|client:), Mongoid.override_database, Mongoid.override_client
Threaded.with_collection_management / managing_collection? (new in lib/mongoid/threaded.rb), exemption for schema-less management ops

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: lib/mongoid/indexable.rb:27-67, lib/mongoid/collection_configurable.rb:24, lib/mongoid/search_indexable.rb:65-114, lib/mongoid/tasks/database.rb:86-180 (fix.diff:1081-1108, fix.diff:400-402, fix.diff:1738-1771, fix.diff:1783-1818); plus the schema producer itself, lib/mongoid/config/encryption.rb:147-162, a second layer from the persistence check

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Index/collection management and the embedded-relation schema walk look unrelated to 'callable database name'; a solver would argue that embedded-only encryption and shared-embed schemas are a separate schema-generation bug, and that rake/index tasks are not data writes.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Collection/index/search-index management and rake db:mongoid tasks for encrypted models must keep working on clients without auto_encryption_options; non-encrypted models must keep working on any client/database; embedded documents use the root's context; a user-supplied :schema_map in config is kept. A fail-closed check in PersistenceContext#client without the management exemption breaks create_indexes/create_collection.

O7_producer.where: lib/mongoid/config/encryption.rb:23-36 called from lib/mongoid/clients/factory.rb:100 at client construction

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Two non-embedded models sharing one namespace (STI sibling subclasses with distinct encrypted fields, or two classes store_in the same collection): the map key is overwritten, so verify sees the key present and one model's encrypted fields are written plaintext.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: STI/shared-collection is a neighbouring schema-merge feature, and the advisory is about callable database names, not key collisions; the fix's check (fix.diff:1713-1715) only tests key presence.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as landing point; cause is in the schema producer, verified only at lib/mongoid/persistence_context.rb (other package)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a collection(parent) / raw client[...] accessor that resolves a client without going through the checked #client path
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the parent branch already builds a collection from parent.collection.with(...) rather than #client; a maintainer adding a fast path for bulk writes could reuse it

O8b_injection_room.sibling: callable :collection in storage_options evaluated once at client build (model.collection_name calls __evaluate__), giving a stale schema key
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: store_in collection: accepts callables via lib/mongoid/persistence_context.rb:95-96 and __evaluate__ at :197-200; the fix skips only callable :database

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Mongoid-module persistence context (transactions/global client) honours client_override/database_override without the schema check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: a second, separate client-resolution path exists for the Mongoid module itself

O9_family: cleartext storage of sensitive data (CWE-312): fail-open client-side field-level encryption due to schema/namespace mismatch
